svg.title: Panic at the Pan — complete system schematic, pin map V2
svg.desc: One self-contained vector drawing: a system connection map and the five complete KiCad circuit sheets. SPI1 and SPI2 are electrically separate. Repeated signal and power labels join the circuit panels. Proposed components and unverified power capacity remain marked.
svg.text: COMPLETE SYSTEM SCHEMATIC / PIN MAP V2 / 09 NOV 2026
132 connection checks + ERC • schematic review; no bench validation
Functional routing; complete component circuits are in panels 01-05.

g.text: 12 V / 5 A: breadboard regulator -> 3.3 V logic (~100 mA allowance); separate 12 V motor branch.
5 V / 3 A: shared display / buffer / sensor / servo / audio rail. All modules share GNDREF.
Signal pin numbers refer to PIC pins.

svg.text: Core supply, ICSP, UART and all allocated PIC pins

g.title: SVG Image created as panic_at_the_pan_interfaces-01 Power + PIC32 core.svg date 2026/11/10 18:04:28
